scope: Actual normal GET and EXPLAIN of the same captured SELECT over the existing isolated native PostgreSQL replay; no source requests or production writes.
cpuUnit: backend clock ticks from /proc stat; Linux USER_HZ normally 100

statement.text:
SELECT p.key, p.source_id, p.record_class, p.scope, p.current_version_id, p.last_known_good_version_id,
    p.promoted_at, (p.validation_receipt - 'excludedFacts') || jsonb_build_object('excludedFacts','[]'::jsonb) validation_receipt,
    (WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(logical),'{}'::text[]) AS exact_keys,
    coalesce(array_agg(logical) FILTER (WHERE logical ~ '^(zip|cell):'),'{}'::text[]) AS location_keys
  FROM (SELECT substring(key FROM 21) AS logical
    FROM unnest($3::text[]) requested(key) WHERE starts_with(key,'open-data-partition:')) keys
), decoded AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reader_payload_node(p.payload) AS header
  WHERE p.record_class='CURATED_READER_RECORD' AND p.source_id IN ('epa-echo','socrata-discovery')
    AND p.scope=p.source_id||':national'
) SELECT CASE
  WHEN p.record_class='CURATED_READER_RECORD' AND p.source_id IN ('epa-echo','socrata-discovery')
    AND p.scope=p.source_id||':national' AND header->>'kind'='open-data' AND header->>'sourceId'=p.source_id
  THEN CASE WHEN header ? 'partitions' THEN reader_payload_value(header-'partitions') || jsonb_build_object('partitions',
    coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(reader_payload_value(item) ORDER BY ordinal_index)
      FROM reader_payload_members(header->'partitions') members
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT reader_payload_node(item)->>'id' AS native_id OFFSET 0) native
      WHERE native.native_id=ANY(selected.exact_keys)
        OR split_part(native.native_id,':state:',1)=ANY(selected.location_keys)), '[]'::jsonb))
    ELSE reader_place_payload(p.payload,$3::text[],NULL) END
  ELSE NULL END FROM decoded CROSS JOIN selected) payload,
    c.retrieved_at, reader_payload_node(c.candidate)->'temporal' temporal FROM civic_data_promotions p
    JOIN civic_data_candidates c ON c.id=p.current_version_id
    WHERE p.record_class=$1 AND p.scope=$2 AND c.state='PROMOTED' AND $3::text[] IS NOT NULL
